## Manual QA Checklist

### S1-01 — Stacked-Sprite + 3D/2D Seam Validation Prototype (Visual/Feel)
**Verification method**: Screenshot comparison + Art Director sign-off
**Who must sign off**: Art Director
**Evidence to capture**: Screenshot(s) of the prototype; written verdict (viable / not-viable / viable with modifications)
**Evidence path**: `production/qa/evidence/s1-01-stacked-sprite-verdict.md`

- [ ] Prototype scene exists in `prototypes/` directory
- [ ] Stacked-sprite technique demonstrated with at least 1 sample asset
- [ ] 3D/2D seam behaviour documented under at least 2 camera angles
- [ ] Art Director has recorded a written verdict (viable / not-viable / viable with modifications)
- [ ] If not-viable: pivot brainstorm scheduled before Sprint 2 begins
- [ ] Screenshot(s) captured and stored in `production/qa/evidence/`

### S1-02 — Risk Register (Config/Data)
**Verification method**: Artifact check
**Who must sign off**: Producer
**Evidence path**: `production/risk-register/`

- [ ] `production/risk-register/` directory exists
- [ ] At least 3 risk entries logged (D1, D2, D3 from gate check)
- [ ] Each entry includes: risk description, probability, impact, mitigation strategy
- [ ] Stacked-sprite seam risk (HIGH) is logged as D1

### S1-04 — ADR-0008 Tower Placement Gate (Config/Data)
**Verification method**: Artifact + structural check
**Who must sign off**: Technical Director
**Evidence path**: `docs/architecture/adr-0008-tower-placement-gate.md`

- [ ] ADR-0008 file exists at the expected path
- [ ] Status is `Accepted` (not `Proposed`)
- [ ] All required sections present: Title, Status, Context, Decision, Consequences, ADR Dependencies, Engine Compatibility, GDD Requirements Addressed
- [ ] `duplicate_deep()` usage policy defined (resolves OQ-4)
- [ ] WAVE_ACTIVE block behaviour specified (Tower.place_tower() returns false)
- [ ] TR-tower-* entries updated in `docs/architecture/tr-registry.yaml`
- [ ] Control manifest regenerated (`/create-control-manifest`) after ADR accepted

### S1-05 — Art Bible Sections 5–6 (Visual/Feel)
**Verification method**: Content review + sign-off
**Who must sign off**: Art Director + Creative Director
**Evidence path**: `design/art/art-bible.md` (appended sections)

- [ ] Section 5 (Character Design Direction) present in art bible
- [ ] Character silhouette vocabulary defined (distinguishable hero vs. enemy vs. tower silhouettes)
- [ ] At least 3 character archetype direction notes present
- [ ] Section 6 (Environment Language) present in art bible
- [ ] Environment material language defined (surface types, texture density guidance)
- [ ] Art Director has reviewed and approved both sections
- [ ] Creative Director consistency check: character + environment language aligns with Sections 1–4

**Verification method**: Content review + sign-off

## Smoke Test Scope

Sprint 1 has no shippable game code. The smoke test is an artifact smoke check:

1. `production/epics/epic-01-foundation.md` exists ✅
2. `production/sprints/sprint-01.md` exists ✅
3. `production/risk-register/` exists with ≥3 risk entries
4. `docs/architecture/adr-0008-tower-placement-gate.md` exists with Status: Accepted
5. `design/art/art-bible.md` contains Sections 5 and 6
6. `production/vertical-slice-target.md` exists with win/fail conditions
7. S1-01 verdict document exists at `production/qa/evidence/s1-01-stacked-sprite-verdict.md`
8. `production/sprint-status.yaml` shows all Must Have stories as `done`

*Run `/smoke-check sprint` at sprint close to gate QA hand-off.*

---

## Playtest Requirements

No playtest sessions required for Sprint 1. The stacked-sprite prototype
(S1-01) requires Art Director evaluation, not a player playtest session.
Sprint 2 will introduce the first playtest requirement when Foundation layer
systems are implemented.

---

## Definition of Done — Sprint 1

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria in `sprint-01.md` verified via documented manual evidence
- [ ] Evidence files exist for all Visual/Feel stories (S1-01, S1-05)
- [ ] All Config/Data stories verified by spot-check or artifact presence
- [ ] Smoke check passes (`/smoke-check sprint` before sprint close)
- [ ] No Sprint 1 Must Have tasks remain in `ready-for-dev` state in `sprint-status.yaml`
- [ ] Stories updated to `done` via `/story-done`
